meta.title: West Coast Picks
meta.subtitle: Ketchikan · Seattle · Nevada City & Tahoe · Reno
notes: Stops: Ketchikan Sept 27–Oct 3, Seattle Oct 3–10, Nevada City & Tahoe City Oct 10–18, Reno Oct 18–22. “Only dates in town” is on by default and hides listings in a town on a date outside that stop — turn it off to see everything found in the five towns. Travel days count as both stops.

Nearby towns are folded into the closest hub: Grass Valley shows appear under Nevada City; Truckee, Incline Village and Crystal Bay under Tahoe City; Sparks, Carson City and Virginia City under Reno. The real town is named in the venue.
Crystal Bay Casino shows are tagged for both Tahoe City and Reno — it sits on Tahoe's north shore, roughly 20 minutes from Tahoe City and 35 minutes from Reno over NV-431. It is 21+.

Ketchikan is genuinely quiet in October: the cruise season closes at the end of September, so Misty Fjords tours, the Lumberjack Show and Saxman performances are likely dark, and the farmers market ended Aug 31. What is listed there is year-round trails, Totem Bight, the Discovery Center (free, Fri/Sat only from Oct 1) and weekly open mics.
Times marked 'time not confirmed' were estimated from a venue's usual schedule, not published.
Strawberry Music Festival's Fall 2026 edition (Oct 15–18, Grass Valley) is cancelled and was excluded.

Sources that returned nothing or blocked automated access: EverOut/The Stranger, Seattle Symphony, Earshot Jazz ticketing, visitktn.com and KRBD calendars, Ketchikan Museum, Pioneer Center Reno, Holland Project, Eventbrite Reno, Washoe County Parks, YubaNet, KVMR, Grass Valley Chamber, South Yuba River State Park events, Go Tahoe North.

events.title: Riverwalk Wine Walk (September)

events.title: Sierra Speaker Series: The Fremont Sierra Expedition

events.title: Lolo Gervais

events.venue: Downtown Nevada City / North Pine Street

events.title: Live Music w/ Cello Joe

events.notes: Truckee, ~15 min from Tahoe City. Three days before the date window.

events.title: Jim Bratt & Friends
events.notes: Genre not specified by venue.

events.title: Crys Matthews

events.title: Al Di Meola

events.address: 314 W Main St, Grass Valley, CA 95945
events.notes: Marquee guitar night but two days before the date window. Grass Valley venue.

events.title: Great Trail Race: Truckee to Tahoe City
events.notes: Classic point-to-point over the ridge, Elite and Classic courses. Date confirmed; start time NOT published - estimated. Falls one day before the date window.

events.title: Carson Valley Trails 'Run the Valley' 2K/5K/10K
events.venue: Carson Valley Trails Association course, Carson City area
events.notes: Trail 2K/5K/10K ~35 min south of Reno. Start time estimated.

events.title: Carson Farmers Market (final 2026 market)

events.title: Genoa Candy Dance Arts & Crafts Faire

events.title: Food X
events.notes: Day before the date window. End time estimated; Miners Foundry did not publish details.

events.title: Oktoberfest at Palisades Tahoe
events.venue: The Village at Palisades Tahoe (Olympic Valley)
events.address: 1960 Olympic Valley Rd, Olympic Valley, CA 96146
events.price: $40 advance / $45 day-of; $13 entry-only; VIP $125-150; kids 12 & under free
events.notes: German beer, Bavarian bands and OktoberGames at the base of Olympic Valley, ~10 min from Tahoe City. One day before the date window opens.

events.title: Samantha Fish w/ The Zac Schulze Gang
events.venue: The Center for the Arts (Grass Valley)
events.address: 314 W Main St, Grass Valley, CA 95945
events.notes: Listed SOLD OUT and one day before the date window. Grass Valley venue.

events.title: Katie Knipp & Pancho
events.notes: Sacramento blues belter and slide player; one day shy of the date window.

events.title: A.J. Croce: Croce Plays Croce
events.notes: Jim Croce songbook played by his son with a roadhouse band - exactly the right flavor, but one night before the date window.

events.title: Social Distortion
events.notes: Mike Ness's roots-punk; doors 7pm. Falls the night before the date window.

events.title: Olympic National Park day trip: Hurricane Ridge / Hoh Rain Forest (ongoing)
events.address: 3002 Mount Angeles Rd, Port Angeles, WA 98362
events.notes: Long day from Seattle (ferry + 2-3hr drive). Hoh Rain Forest is the closest mainland analogue to Ketchikan's Tongass rainforest. Check nps.gov for Hurricane Ridge road hours and any closures.

events.title: Mount Rainier NP fall color day trip (ongoing, with October closures)
events.notes: Subalpine color at Paradise peaks late Sept-early Oct. NOTE: the Sunrise road closes to vehicles at the White River gate after ~Oct 8, and Stevens Canyon Rd has construction closures. Longmire and the Paradise area stay open. Confirm conditions before driving.

events.title: Flume Trail & Tahoe Rim Trail (fall riding and hiking)
events.venue: Tahoe Meadows to Spooner / Tahoe Rim Trail
events.address: Tahoe Meadows Trailhead, NV-431, Incline Village, NV 89451
events.notes: The IMBA Epic - 1,600 ft of cliff-edge flume above the lake, and October is the best month for it (no heat, no crowds). Trailhead is ~35 min from Tahoe City on the Nevada side. Check tahoerimtrail.org for early-snow closures.

events.title: Deer Mountain Trail (year-round trailhead)
events.address: Ketchikan Lakes Rd / Deermount St, Ketchikan, AK 99901
events.notes: Ketchikan's iconic backdrop: ~5 miles, 2,600 ft gain, trailhead walkable from downtown. Open year-round but expect mud, heavy rain and possible early snow above treeline in October. The first 1-1.5 miles to the lower overlooks is the realistic autumn option.

events.title: Totem Bight State Historical Park (year-round, free)
events.notes: 14 restored totems and a clan house on a wooded shoreline 10 miles north of town, open year-round, no fee, self-guided. Works fine without a tour bus and is unusually good in low October light.

events.title: Washington Park Arboretum fall color (ongoing)
events.notes: 230 acres; Azalea Way and the Japanese maples peak mid-to-late October. Free, open dawn to dusk. Best single fall-color walk inside Seattle city limits.

events.title: Discovery Park Loop Trail & West Point Lighthouse (ongoing)
events.notes: 2.8-mile loop through bluff meadow and forest with Olympics and Sound views. Visitor center has maps; check the seasonal shuttle for lighthouse beach access.

events.title: Pike Place Market (ongoing, permanent public market)
events.notes: Not an event — a permanent daily market (roughly 9am-6pm, farm/craft stalls vary by day). Listed once as a standing option: fish, produce, Rachel's Ginger Beer, Pike Place Chowder, the original Starbucks queue.

events.title: Ballard Farmers Market (Sundays, year-round)
events.address: Ballard Ave NW between 20th & 22nd Ave NW, Seattle, WA 98107
events.notes: Seattle's original year-round neighborhood market, Sundays 9am-2pm, Washington-grown only. Falls on Sep 27, Oct 4, 11 and 18 during the trip. Rain or shine.

events.title: South Yuba River State Park - Independence Trail & Bridgeport Covered Bridge
events.address: 17660 Pleasant Valley Rd, Penn Valley, CA 95946
events.notes: Flume-turned-trail, largely level and accessible, plus the longest single-span covered bridge in the US. Fall is the best season - low water, no crowds. The park's own events page was 'under construction'; call the visitor center for scheduled naturalist walks.

events.title: Malakoff Diggins SHP - hydraulic mining pit & North Bloomfield ghost town
events.address: 23579 N Bloomfield-Graniteville Rd, Nevada City, CA 95959
events.notes: Otherworldly eroded cliffs from hydraulic mining, ~45 min up a winding road from Nevada City. Best in dry fall weather; check road conditions.

events.title: Downieville Downhill mountain biking (shuttle season)
events.notes: Legendary 15-mile shuttle-served descent, ~1 hr north of Nevada City. Shuttles typically run into October weather permitting - confirm dates directly, they were not published.

events.title: Apple Hill harvest season (Placerville)
events.notes: Peak apple/cider/pie season runs September through October across 50+ ranches. It's ~1 hr 45 min south of Nevada City, so it's a detour rather than a day trip - best combined with a drive toward Tahoe.

events.title: Page Meadows loop hike
events.address: Silver Tip Dr, Tahoe City, CA 96145
events.notes: Easy meadow-and-aspen loop literally minutes from downtown Tahoe City - the single best low-effort fall color walk in the area.

events.title: Kayak & SUP on Lake Tahoe from Commons Beach
events.address: 400 N Lake Blvd, Tahoe City, CA 96145
events.notes: Glassy water and empty shoreline in early October, but rental operators wind down mid-month and afternoon winds pick up - go early and confirm the outfitter is still open.

events.title: Sugar Pine Point State Park & Tahoe State Recreation Area
events.notes: Ehrman Mansion grounds, old-growth pines and a quiet stretch of west shore, ~15 min south of Tahoe City. Mansion tour season typically ends in fall - confirm before driving down.

events.title: Rainbird Trail (year-round, in-town rainforest walk)
events.address: Third Ave Bypass / UAS Ketchikan campus, Ketchikan, AK 99901
events.notes: Moderate ~1.3-mile in-town trail through genuine Southeast Alaska rainforest with downtown and Tongass Narrows views. Ideal for a wet October morning with no car.

events.title: Ward Lake Nature Trail & Ward Creek (year-round)
events.venue: Ward Lake Recreation Area, Tongass National Forest
events.notes: Flat 1-mile gravel loop around a lake under old-growth spruce and hemlock, ~7 miles north of town. The easiest, most reliable Tongass experience in October; late coho may still be in Ward Creek. Connects to the longer Ward Creek trail.

events.title: Perseverance Lake Trail (year-round)
events.venue: Perseverance Trailhead, Ward Lake Recreation Area
events.notes: Easy ~4.4 miles round trip, ~450 ft gain, much of it boardwalk, ending at a mountain lake. A local favorite and very doable in the rain.

events.title: Saxman Native Village & Totem Park
events.address: 2.5 Mile S Tongass Hwy, Saxman, AK 99901
events.notes: CAVEAT: the world's largest standing collection of totem poles, but the narrated tours, carving-shed demonstrations and Cape Fox dance performances are built around the cruise season and are unlikely to be running in October. The grounds are generally walkable — call Cape Fox Tours first.

events.title: Salmon viewing at the Ballard Locks fish ladder (ongoing)
events.notes: Underwater viewing windows; coho run typically holds into October, though numbers thin as the month goes on. Free, open daily, and the botanical garden next door is good fall color.

events.title: Taste of Seattle guided food walking tours (ongoing)
events.venue: Pike Place Market / Capitol Hill / Downtown
events.notes: Runs most days October through December. Book a specific departure time — the listed time here is a placeholder.

events.title: Empire Mine State Historic Park - grounds, gardens & mine yard
events.address: 10791 E Empire St, Grass Valley, CA 95945
events.notes: One of the richest hardrock gold mines in California, with 14 miles of trails and the Bourn Cottage gardens. ~10 min from Nevada City. Docent tour schedule not published for these dates.

events.title: Yuba River swimming holes & recreational gold panning
events.venue: South Yuba River (Highway 49 Crossing / Edwards Crossing)
events.notes: Water is cold by October but the granite pools and riverside walking are still the local ritual. The park's formal gold-panning demos run Memorial Day-Labor Day only; self-guided panning is allowed year-round with a hand pan.

events.title: Misty Fjords National Monument flightseeing & boat tours (seasonal)
events.notes: MAJOR CAVEAT: this is the great Ketchikan experience, but the main cruise season is May-September and most operators either stop or go on-call in October. Some small flightseeing outfits (e.g. Island Wings) will fly for private bookings when weather allows. October weather in Southeast scrubs a high share of flights. Call ahead, book a flexible date, and have a backup plan. Price is a typical in-season range, not a confirmed October quote.

events.title: Tongass Historical Museum & Totem Heritage Center (winter hours)
events.address: 629 Dock St / 601 Deermount St, Ketchikan, AK 99901
events.notes: The Totem Heritage Center holds 19th-century unrestored poles recovered from abandoned village sites — the most striking indoor thing in Ketchikan. Both switch to reduced winter hours after cruise season; I could not load the October calendar. Call (907) 225-3111 to confirm days and hours before going.

events.title: Great Alaskan Lumberjack Show (seasonal - likely closed)
events.notes: CAVEAT: Ketchikan's best-known tourist show, but it runs on the cruise schedule and 2026 closing dates were not published on their site. Almost certainly finished for the season by late September/early October. Call (907) 225-9050 before counting on it.

events.title: Dasty Island - End of Summer Party
events.notes: Easy first-night option in walking distance of downtown Nevada City. Golden Era's calendar past Sept 27 was not published as of this search.

events.title: Bluegrass Sundays at Alibi Truckee
events.venue: Alibi Ale Works - Truckee Public House
events.notes: Weekly brewery bluegrass session - low-key, local, exactly the right hang. Venue is in downtown Truckee, ~15 min from Tahoe City.

events.title: Weekly open mics: New York Cafe, Sun/Tue/Thu nights (recurring)
events.venue: New York Cafe / various Ketchikan venues
events.notes: CONFIRMED for September, October NOT confirmed: the Arts Council calendar lists Sunday open mic with Joe Williams IV (6pm), Tuesday open mic (6pm), Thursday open mic with Evan Porter & Mario Sumner (8pm). These are the realistic way to hear live music in an 8,000-person town in October. Check ketchikanarts.org or call (907) 225-2211 the week you arrive.

events.title: Groundation w/ The Quasi Kings
events.notes: Long-form roots reggae with a heavy jazz/jam streak — arrival-night option in Fremont.

events.title: Brian Fallon & The Painkillers
events.notes: Gaslight Anthem frontman solo; Springsteen-adjacent. Doors 7pm, 21+.

events.title: Bill Frisell & Harmony Five
events.venue: The Center for the Arts (Grass Valley)
events.address: 314 W Main St, Grass Valley, CA 95945
events.notes: Frisell's Americana-leaning vocal project - jazz with a folk heart. Lands on day one of the trip. Grass Valley venue, ~10 min from Nevada City.

events.title: Songwriter In The Round: Aimee Lefkowicz, Jade Teather, Where's Beth, Frankie Beach
events.notes: Low-key in-the-round night; cheap way to hear four local songwriters in Ballard.

events.title: Los Tigres del Norte
events.notes: Legendary norteño band; first night of the date window.

events.title: Music Mondays | Open Mic
events.venue: Alibi Ale Works - Truckee Public House
events.notes: Truckee, ~15 min from Tahoe City.

events.title: Tractor Square Dance! Sparklebrite w/ Suzanne Girardot calling
events.notes: Live old-time string band with a caller — the most fun $12 in Ballard and a Tractor institution.

events.title: An Evening with Jorma Kaukonen
events.venue: The Center for the Arts (Grass Valley)
events.address: 314 W Main St, Grass Valley, CA 95945
events.notes: Jefferson Airplane / Hot Tuna founder, deep fingerstyle blues - the most Dead-adjacent bill of the trip's first week. Grass Valley venue.

events.title: Isaiah Collier: Collier Plays Coltrane
events.notes: Two nights. Fiery young tenor player working the Coltrane songbook — strong for jam-minded listeners.

events.title: Grace Cummings: The Bloodhorse! Tour
events.notes: Australian singer with an enormous, Joplin-ish voice — small room, big payoff.

events.title: Reno Philharmonic: Jurassic Park in Concert
events.notes: Full film with the Reno Phil playing John Williams live; doors 5pm.

events.title: Fantastic Cat w/ The Pop Cycle
events.notes: Americana 'supergroup' of four songwriters (Anthony D'Amato, Brian Dunne, Don DiLego, Mike Montali).

events.title: Hauntober in Virginia City (ghost walks, Gold Hill Hotel haunted tours Oct 8/15/29)
events.notes: Month-long programming in one of America's most-claimed-haunted towns; the walking is the point. ~35 min from Reno.

events.title: Polio Purple Pinkie Trail Run (3K/5K/10K)
events.notes: Small Rotary-run trail race right in town. Start time and exact venue not confirmed.

events.title: Nevada City / Grass Valley Fall Color
events.notes: Chamber calls this one of California's best foliage areas; liquidambar and maple peak mid-to-late October right in the Victorian streets. Ongoing, no fixed times.

events.title: Kokanee Salmon Run at Taylor Creek
events.venue: Taylor Creek Visitor Center / Rainbow Trail (South Lake Tahoe)
events.address: Visitor Center Rd, South Lake Tahoe, CA 96150
events.notes: LANDS SQUARELY IN THE TRIP WINDOW - October is the run, with the creek turning bright red and the Rainbow Trail stream profile chamber letting you watch underwater. Caveat: it's on the SOUTH shore, ~1 hr from Tahoe City, and in drought years low flows have blocked the run. The associated Fall Fish Festival is usually the first weekend of October but no 2026 date was published anywhere I could find.

events.title: Fall Aspen Color - Page Meadows, Hope Valley, Taylor Creek
events.address: Page Meadows Trailhead, Tahoe City, CA 96145
events.notes: PEAK IS THE SECOND OR THIRD WEEK OF OCTOBER - dead center of the trip. Page Meadows is the walkable one, minutes from Tahoe City; Hope Valley (~1hr south) is the spectacular one. Higher elevations turn first. Exact peak shifts with cold snaps.

events.title: Keep It Dark Astrotourism Weekend
events.notes: Multi-day dark-sky programming; Truckee area, ~15 min from Tahoe City.

events.title: Al Di Meola Acoustic Ensemble
events.notes: Four-night run Thu-Sun. Virtuoso acoustic guitar; improv-heavy.

events.title: Punch Brothers
events.notes: TOP PICK. Chris Thile's band in a beautiful 1907 theatre — the marquee roots show of the whole window. Book early.

events.title: Community Connections: Under the Tahoe Stars
events.notes: Part of the Keep It Dark weekend. Truckee, ~15 min from Tahoe City.

events.title: The Golden Road (2 sets)
events.notes: Seattle's Dead band doing two full sets — the obvious Dead pick of the trip.

events.title: Old Crow Medicine Show w/ Meels
events.notes: The single best roots show of the date window - stomping old-time string band in a proper theater. Doors 7pm.

events.title: Southeast Alaska Discovery Center (open Fri & Sat, free in winter)
events.notes: CONFIRMED: from Oct 1 the hours drop to Fridays and Saturdays only, 8am-4pm, and admission becomes free (it's $5 May-Sept). Best rainy-day orientation to the Tongass rainforest, Native cultures and the fishing industry. Plan a Friday or Saturday.

events.title: Seattle Greek Festival
events.notes: Gyros, souvlaki, lamb, a Greek deli and dancers in Montlake. Free entry, pay per plate. Times estimated.

events.title: OffBeat Music Festival 2026 (of Montreal, RJD2, Polyrhythmics, Ron Gallo, Grace Cummings, Tristen)
events.venue: Lead Dog Brewing + Reno Brewery District / Midtown venues
events.notes: Reno's best homegrown multi-venue festival; ~37 acts over two days. Polyrhythmics is the funk-jam pick. Start time estimated.

events.title: Dragon Lights Reno: 'Many Worlds Aglow'
events.venue: Wilbur D. May Arboretum, Rancho San Rafael Regional Park
events.notes: Giant silk lanterns through the arboretum, 6-10pm nightly Oct 2-Nov 1. A good after-dark walk in a real park.

events.title: Beautiful Anarchy: Burlesque Show w/ Live Music
events.venue: Alibi Ale Works - Truckee Public House
events.notes: 21+. Truckee, ~15 min from Tahoe City.

events.title: The Aquabats w/ sullvn
events.notes: Marquee-venue show, not roots. Fun if you have kids along.

events.title: Live Music at the New York Cafe, Fridays (recurring)
events.notes: CONFIRMED for September, October NOT confirmed: the Arts Council calendar lists live music at the New York Cafe every Friday at 7pm. Falls on Oct 2, 9, 16 during the trip. Confirm locally.

events.title: Tyler Childers
events.notes: Biggest Americana draw of the window. Arena show — expect high resale. Time estimated.

events.title: Mountain Grass Unit - Appalachian Smoke Tour
events.notes: Young Alabama newgrass band with serious chops — best straight-ahead bluegrass on the Seattle calendar this window.

events.title: Bird Fest 2026
events.venue: Washoe Lake State Park, South Day Use Area
events.address: 4855 E Lake Blvd, Washoe Valley, NV 89704
events.notes: Guided bird walk at 7am, festival 10am-2pm: owl-pellet dissection, ID skills, presentations every 30 min. Washoe Lake is ~25 min south of Reno, mid-migration.

events.title: North Bend Trail Fest
events.notes: Trail race in the Snoqualmie foothills; multiple distances. Time estimated.

events.title: The Village Market on California Avenue (final 2026 market)
events.notes: Last Saturday of this well-liked midtown-adjacent market for 2026 - season runs May 30 to Oct 3.

events.title: Nevada City Farmers Market (Saturdays)
events.notes: Confirmed running Saturdays 8:30am-1pm April 11 through December 20, 2026 - so EVERY Saturday of the trip (Oct 3, 10, 17) is live. Peak harvest: apples, pears, winter squash.

events.title: Issaquah Salmon Days Festival (57th annual)
events.venue: Historic Downtown Issaquah & Issaquah Salmon Hatchery
events.notes: Watch spawning salmon at the hatchery, then 400 vendors, a salmon BBQ, parade and live music. The single best outdoors-plus-food day of the trip.

events.title: OysterFest (Washington State Seafood Festival)
events.notes: The Northwest's big oyster festival — oyster shucking championships, food pavilion, wine and microbrews, two music stages. About 1hr 45min from Seattle. Times estimated.

events.title: Skagit Valley Farm to Pint / Farm Festival
events.notes: Self-guided tour of a dozen Skagit Valley farms, 10am-4pm — samples, farmers, animals. About an hour north.

events.title: Fishermen's Festival
events.notes: Free Ballard seafood festival at the working fishing fleet's home dock — seafood vendors, live music, beer garden, ship canal tours, 11am-6pm. Very Seattle.

events.title: U District Food Walk
events.notes: Car-free Ave with $6 tasting plates from 70 businesses, 11am-8pm. Cheap, walkable, and a great cross-section of Seattle's immigrant food scene.

events.title: Downtown Truckee Wine, Walk & Shop
events.notes: 25-30 tasting stops through the historic railroad downtown, commemorative glass and food bites included. Truckee, ~15 min from Tahoe City. (One listing says 11am-4pm, the detailed one says 12-4pm - arrive at noon.)

events.title: World Championship Outhouse Races
events.notes: Costumed teams push decorated outhouses down a 19th-century mining-town main street. Virginia City is ~35 min southeast of Reno.

events.title: OktoBEARfest
events.notes: 10 tastes from 50 Northwest breweries and cideries inside the zoo, 1-7pm. Zoo admission usually included — confirm.

events.title: A Liar's Cruise (Tahoe Gal)
events.address: 952 N Lake Blvd, Tahoe City, CA 96145
events.notes: Actually departs from Tahoe City itself - a fall afternoon on the lake with tall-tale storytelling, run by the Sierra State Parks Foundation. Rare in-town Tahoe City event.

events.title: Great Pumpkin Beer Festival
events.notes: 60+ pumpkin and seasonal beers, live music, costume contest, 4-10pm. Elysian's signature fall event and a Seattle institution.

events.title: North Bend Blues Walk (22 bands, 18 venues)
events.notes: Whole-town blues crawl 6pm-midnight, ~35 min east of Seattle. Pairs well with a Snoqualmie-area hike that afternoon.

events.title: Astro Photography Workshop: Milky Way in the Meadow
events.notes: Donner Summit, ~30 min from Tahoe City.

events.title: An Evening with Carbon Leaf
events.notes: Two-set 'evening with' format from a long-running Celtic-tinged Americana band.

events.title: Deer Tick
events.notes: Ragged, reliably great alt-country live band. Time estimated — confirm on Neumos site.

events.title: Fruit Bats (presented by folkYEAH!)
events.venue: The Center for the Arts (Grass Valley)
events.address: 314 W Main St, Grass Valley, CA 95945
events.notes: Eric D. Johnson's long-running indie-folk project; he's also a third of Bonny Light Horseman. Grass Valley venue.

events.title: Pat Benatar & Neil Giraldo
events.notes: Marquee casino show, not roots.

events.title: Truth or Dare presents: Monsters & Martinis
events.notes: Late-night Halloween-season variety show in California's oldest operating theatre (1865). End time estimated.

events.title: Rock Reno Half Marathon, Relay & 5K
events.venue: Start: Swift Sportsdome (half) / Greater Nevada Field (5K)
events.notes: Point-to-point along the Truckee River bike path, finishing on the field at the Reno Aces ballpark. Half starts 8:00, 5K 8:15.

events.title: Riverside Farmers Market (Sundays, year-round)
events.notes: The one Reno market that runs all year - producer-only, in a riverside park. Every Sunday: Oct 4, 11, 18. Confirmed October dates.

events.title: Bluegrass Sundays at Alibi Truckee
events.venue: Alibi Ale Works - Truckee Public House
events.notes: Second confirmed date of the weekly series. Alibi's calendar did not publish Bluegrass Sundays past Oct 4 - worth checking again closer to the trip, it may well continue. Truckee, ~15 min from Tahoe City.

events.title: Marty Stuart & His Fabulous Superlatives
events.venue: The Center for the Arts (Grass Valley)
events.address: 314 W Main St, Grass Valley, CA 95945
events.notes: Ex-Lester Flatt and Johnny Cash sideman with the best band in country music; heavy bluegrass and psych-country streak. Grass Valley venue.

events.title: Truckee Certified Farmers Market (Tuesdays)
events.notes: Season runs mid-May to MID-OCTOBER, and Oct 6 is the last date the calendar confirms - so this is likely the final or near-final market of the year. Truckee, ~15 min from Tahoe City.

events.title: Paula Cole w/ Rett Madison
events.venue: The Center for the Arts (Grass Valley)
events.address: 314 W Main St, Grass Valley, CA 95945
events.notes: Grass Valley venue, ~10 min from Nevada City.

events.title: Will Varley w/ guests
events.notes: UK folk troubadour; Sunset is a 200-cap Ballard room a block from the Tractor.

events.title: Earshot Jazz Festival 2026 (38th annual)
events.notes: Oct 7-25, 30+ concerts at a dozen-plus venues. The single best music anchor for the Seattle stretch — browse the schedule and pick 2-3.

events.title: Bellevue Jazz & Blues Series
events.notes: Five days of mostly-free jazz and blues across Bellevue; headline sets are ticketed.
